description: Cancel a video that has NOT started rendering: a draft, a video still queued (PENDING), or one whose failed render is waiting for an automatic retry. The video ends as FAILED "Cancelled" and is never rendered. Credits are charged only after a render succeeds, so normally nothing had been charged; if the ledger holds a charge for it, exactly that is refunded (idempotent, never twice) and refundedCredits says how much. A video that is already rendering, finished, or a clip made straight from a prompt is refused (CANNOT_CANCEL_STARTED) and left untouched. Requires the "video:create" scope.
name: cancel_video
title: Cancel a video
